plan.failureSummary: Deterministic cache replay failed to locate the 'Last Name' input field because the survey form dynamically shifted fields to 'Your Name'.
observedIndicators: Failure occurred inside .cache-lock/unstable-survey.test.ts.cache.js during deterministic replay.
The cached instructions expected a 'Last Name *' field with selector [data-testid='input-lastname'], but the live failure screenshot shows 'Your Name *' and 'Contact Email *'.
The overall objective is semantically flexible ('Fill out the all of the survey questions with fake data...').
Application logs and console report 0 errors.

remediationSteps.summary: Clear cache and retry autonomous run
remediationSteps.details: Clear the Page.AI cache for tests/unstable-survey.test.ts and re-run the test autonomously.

additionalDataRequests.description: Inspect the unstable survey variation parameters if layout shifts are expected to dynamically rotate across runs.

plan.notes: The test objective explicitly anticipates dynamic layout and field shifts across loads. Replaying deterministic cached selectors for a specific form variation caused the step to fail. Clearing the cache and allowing autonomous page.ai execution will resolve the issue.
